source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 717 exactly restores both pre-713 blobs. Entry 725 relands the cleanup with one production difference: it no longer assigns gViewWrapper = null. The current folder listener clears gFolder, closes the wrapper with leavingFolder false, updates the header, and clears the message selection. _onSelect tolerates a missing gDBView. Preserve this distinct wrapper/view lifetime. The specific test failure caused by nulling the wrapper remains an inference until D220240 and Bug 1913328 are read.
title: Close the deleted folder view while retaining its wrapper object
